_doc: Services whose image is pinned by tag AND digest (doc 87): the ones another device or the internet can reach. Keep the tag for readers; Dependabot (docker-compose ecosystem) proposes new tags, and the weekly supply-chain-watch job runs tools/digest_check.py, which reports any pinned tag that moved to a new build (--write takes it). local/compose/tests/test_container_hardening.py fails if one loses its @sha256 pin.

docker-compose.yml.guiding-map: the Life OS web server: published on BIND_HOST (other devices) and reached as hub.<domain> through the tunnel
docker-compose.yml.open-webui: Chat: published on BIND_HOST and reached as chat.<domain> through the tunnel
docker-compose.yml.cloudflared: the online tunnel: the one container that talks to the internet for the estate
docker-compose.yml.vaultwarden: the password manager: published on BIND_HOST for the Bitwarden apps on phones and laptops
docker-compose.yml.anythingllm: private document chat: published on BIND_HOST
docker-compose.yml.studio: Code Studio (VS Code + Cline): the browser coding GUI, published on BIND_HOST and reached as hub.<domain>/studio/ through the edge

tls.yml.tls-edge: the TLS edge: the one HTTPS port every device reaches (BIND_HOST:443)

stage-sprout.yml.seaweedfs: object storage (sprout stage): published on BIND_HOST
